MonumentStudio | A memorial design workflow
Actual application. Fictional example.

Choose an oval top and adjust dimensions.
Both elevations use the same inch-based model.

Add the family name, dates, and a line of remembrance.
Every detail in this demonstration is fictional.

Position the lettering precisely.
Move the selected line in quarter-inch steps.

Oversized lettering triggers a real layout warning.
The guide is preliminary; final engraving clearance still needs review.

Review calculated face area and solid volume.
These estimates do not establish weight or manufacturing approval.

Save explicitly, refresh, then reopen the saved design.
This save belongs to this browser and device.

Download the high-resolution design image.
The real PNG contains both elevations at 3840 × 2440 pixels.

Generate a PDF summary of the same design.
It includes dimensions, lettering, calculations, and limitations.

Prepare a preliminary proposal with optional review notes.
It is not a quote, contract, or production approval.

One design connects editing, recovery, and documents.
Human review remains essential.
